<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Circle</title>
  <style>
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html,
    body {
      height: 100%;
    }

    body {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: #f4f4f5;
      color: #18181b;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    svg {
      display: block;
      width: min(400px, 90vmin);
      height: auto;
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      body {
        background: #18181b;
        color: #f4f4f5;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <svg
    viewBox="0 0 400 400"
    role="img"
    aria-labelledby="circle-title circle-desc"
  >
    <title id="circle-title">Circle</title>
    <desc id="circle-desc">A solid circle centered in a square canvas.</desc>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200" fill="currentColor"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
Updated `0.html` with these improvements:

- **Layout fixes.** Replaced the 100vw/100vh sizing, which causes horizontal scrollbars, with a full-height grid that centers the content. Added universal box-sizing.
- **Responsive SVG.** The circle now scales down on small screens instead of being fixed at 400px and overflowing.
- **Accessibility.** The SVG has a role, a title, and a description so screen readers announce it meaningfully.
- **Theming.** The circle uses the text color, and a dark mode media query flips the background and foreground automatically.
- **Cleanup.** Replaced the hash-like page title and SVG id with a readable title, and set a system font stack for any future text.

The circle itself is unchanged in shape and position. Open the file in a browser to verify.
